data.gender_notes: Furkhan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the Lord of the Moon. Furkhan is a name derived from the Persian word 'Farokh', meaning 'Lord' and the Arabic word 'Khan', meaning 'Ruler'. This name is associated with the Hindu god, Krishna, who is often depicted as the Moon God and the Lord of the Universe. The name Furkhan carries the meaning “Lord of the Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Furkhan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furkhan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
